---
title: Appendix with shifted headings
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
shift-heading-level-by: -1
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          dash="$(printf '\342\200\224')"
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "1 Intro.*Deep.*2 Methods.*Appendix A $dash Extra.*A.1 Detail" || { echo "wrong order"; exit 1; }
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF 'Figure A.1: Extra square' || { echo "missing: Figure A.1"; exit 1; }
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'sections:.*level-1.*Deep'
---

## Intro

The body.

### Deep {.appendix}

Deep text.

## Extra {.appendix}

![Extra square.](figure.svg){#fig-extra fig-alt="A blue square."}

### Detail

Detail text.

## Methods

The methods.
